text: Detective Dima? Iris Vasilescu. Thirty-four. Found dead yesterday morning. A head injury the first report cannot explain. The room is yours.
Her sister called twice while we waited. First she asked what had happened. Then she asked if the lamp was still on.
Leave it on. I will start with the room.
Nothing has been put back. There is an authorised phone copy on the side table. Take your time. Then tell me what you can actually establish.
What should the search team be looking for?
Which original gives us the latest known view of it still here?
Then what do you make of the furniture?
And what can that comparison establish? Be precise.
Iris was found here yesterday. The body is with the examiner. I have kept the room as it was. Start with the room and the phone copy. I will wait on the landing.
Elena. Her sister. She asked me to leave the lamp on. I do not think she meant it as evidence.
The photographs were taken before removal. We have not straightened a chair or returned anything to a shelf. That is all I can tell you about the arrangement.
All right. Show me the difference, and something that tells us when it was already there. A room can change for more than one reason.
You have a possibility. I need a comparison. Keep the original image, not just the impression it gives you.
That does not agree with the originals you have shown me. Keep looking. We do not need an answer quickly; we need one that holds.
There is an interval. Do not turn it into a time of death, or a name. What can the two sources actually establish?
Yes. The earlier original changes the question. I will have the search request written that way. You have kept what the image can prove separate from what it cannot.
The receiving desk at the Aurelia has kept its own records. I will arrange access. Leave this room as it is; we may need to come back to it.
Do not start with a person. Start with what is physically different between this room and an original photograph.
A photograph can belong to a different day. Check the original capture information before using a changed arrangement to explain the death.
There is a retained image inside the unsent message. Compare both the furniture and the lower shelf. You can zoom, and use the image description if that is clearer.
Do not throw the blue mug out. It only leaks if I put anything in it. And please do not fix it so well that it stops being my mug.
